verdicts.reason: A is jumbled. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges and sits in the same row, so it is buried. The subtitle floats in the middle between the headline and the date, the 'Sunset Sessions' headline runs right down to the bottom edge, and the fine print and broken-asset box are tiny and jammed into the bottom-right corner. B has a readable left-to-right column order (brand and headline with the subtitle under it, then details, badges and CTA), but the RSVP button is still undersized compared with the badges, the subtitle wraps to leave 'year' on its own line, the logo sits awkwardly at the bottom of the left column, the product card and the broken asset are cut off at the right edge, and the fine print is too small to read.
